statement: Mean sentence length is between 3 and 10 words in the 14 analysed books with text; the longest sentence stays at or under 14 words in 9 of 14 (the others reach 18-21).

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (13), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver/Pratham Books (1); 2014-2025
